headContext: The `findUserById` helper concatenates user-controlled input directly into a SQL string. A SQL-injection positive — the deterministic static-analysis rule `sql-concat` catches this (a Semgrep-derived high/security finding, UT-static-sql-01).

groundTruth.note: User input concatenated into a SQL string — a the static-analysis `sql-concat` rule fires here (a deterministic finding, exempt from the confidence floor, ADR-005).

cleanAssertions.note: The `runQuery` helper itself (a the unchanged line) is not a finding.
